messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-37412 fired: automated threshold exceeded — edge-gateway-usw2 reporting 502 rate 6.1% over 5m window. Severity: P1. Link: https://pd.example/PD-37412
alex: Acked PD-37412 :white_check_mark:
alex: I'm on it, pulling dashboards now — spike concentrated on /v1/generate via edge-proxy in az3
maria: seeing 502s too, any recent infra deploys?
jordan: CI shows only an app canary ~12m ago, no infra deploys in last 30m
alex: tailing proxy logs and upstream traces, grabbing first batch
alex: ```shell
kubectl logs -n prod edge-proxy-az3 -c proxy --since=15m | grep ' 502 ' | head -50
# ... log snippet showing repeated upstream 502 + connection reset by peer
```
maria: those traces show "connection reset by peer" from the model-backend pool, could be backend saturation or kv cache thrash
ops-bot: Runbook link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/edge-5xx — follow mitigation sections 1 and 3 for traffic shift and cache restart
alex: starting a temporary route-weight shift to healthy az (edge-az1) to reduce pressure on az3
alex: executed: `infra traffic shift --from=edge-az3 --to=edge-az1 --percent=60` — watching for 30s window
jordan: any customer-facing alerts? CS says a small number of customers reported timeouts, not a broad outage
alex: metrics: total 502 rate falling in az1, az3 still elevated
maria: suggest warming kv cache on az3 and restart kv worker pods — might clear the hung backends
maria: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/kv-cache -n infra --grace-period=30`
alex: doing kv-cache restart now
pagerduty: PD-37412 acknowledged by alex at 2026-03-17T02:14:38Z
jordan: if load pressure persists we can temporarily route requests to the quantized-model variant to reduce backend latency
maria: also patched proxy keepalive on az3 (test) to 10s to reduce idle resets: `kubectl patch deployment edge-proxy -n prod -p '{"spec":...}'`
alex: kv-cache pods restarted, monitoring reconnect logs
ops-bot: Created mitigation ticket RED-INC-37412 and assigned SRE rotation for post-incident review
alex: error rate overall down to ~0.9%, az3 at ~1.2% — still above baseline but much improved
maria: leaving a regen job warming caches in az3 for next 20 minutes
alex: will hand off to night oncall @jordan in 15m. brief for handoff:
- what: edge gateway 502 spike (peak ~6%)
- impact: small subset of customer requests timed out; no data loss or degraded ML outputs observed
- mitigation: shifted traffic to az1, restarted kv-cache in az3, adjusted proxy keepalive setting for az3
- next steps: observe 30m window, monitor kv cache thrash, review canary from app team for backend changes
jordan: ack, I'll monitor logs and PD alerts. ping me in #oncall if it reappears
maria: preparing a short note for customer-ops: "Limited 502 spike affecting ~0.3% of requests, mitigated by traffic shift and cache restart. We'll notify affected customers if recurrence occurs."
alex: thanks team — marking thread as resolved if stable for next 20m
incident-bot: PD-37412 auto-resolved (no new alerts) at 2026-03-17T02:35:30Z :white_check_mark:
